title: SERENDIPITY: phase III multicentric randomized study assessing the reduction of chronic prostate inflammation with Permixon®
official: SERENDIPITY: phase III multicentric randomized study assessing the reduction of chronic prostate inflammation with Permixon®
summary:
Main objective: Reduction of the necessity to perform a new prostate biopsy evaluated with the downgrade of the PIRADS area at MRI and/or the potential reduction of the PSA value (re-biopsy compared between groups)
after 12 months of Permixon® treatment
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male patients aged between 45 and 85 with LUTS/BPH
2. Who signed and dated informed consent for participation in the trial obtained according to ICH GCP, and national/local regulations
3. Total PSA value > 4 ng/mL (data collected within 6 months from the inclusion) and/or  PIRADS areas ≥3 at mpMRI (data collected within 6 months from the inclusion).
4. Who underwent a prostate biopsy within 4 months from randomization
5. Histologically confirmed chronic non-specific inflammation and absence of PCa
Exclusion criteria:
1. Unable or unwilling to sign the informed consent
2. Personal history of or planned prostatic surgery for LUTS/BPH
3. Pathological bladder conditions that can promote infectious diseases (i.e.: diverticula, neurological bladder, etc.).
4. Personal history of UTIs caused by multi-resistant bacteria less than 3 months prior to randomization
5. Any form of immunosuppression
6. Use of chronic therapy with anti-inflammatory drugs
7. Personal history of cancer or suspected metastatic disease
8. Who not underwent to total serum PSA determination and mpMRI within 6 months from randomization
9. Not suited to follow a long-term treatment
10. Previous treatment with Permixon®, discontinued less than 12 months prior to randomization
11. Allergy to the active substance or to any of the other components of Permixon®.
12. Active treatment with 5-ARIs or discontinued less than 2 months prior to total serum PSA determination baseline
13. Diagnosis of PCa, PIN HG (Prostatic Intraepithelial Neoplasia High-Grade) and/or ASAP (Atypical Small Acinar Proliferation).
14. Prostate biopsy performed more than 4 months prior to randomization
15. Negative prostate biopsy for chronic inflammation or positive for malignancy
